import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
    
    bestDiff = 1e15
    p = 0
    q = 0
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        raw = x * i / y
        tx = int(math.floor(raw + 0.5 - 1e-7))
        
        diff = abs(x / y - tx / i)
        
        if diff < bestDiff:
            bestDiff = diff
            p = tx
            q = i
    
    print(f"{p}/{q}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
